about_short_description.short_description: Nory is the all-knowing restaurant management system that learns the behind the scenes of your business.

product.name: Business Intelligence
product.description: Provides real-time insights and AI-predictive analytics on sales, costs, labor, and waste to support decision-making in restaurant operations.

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: Manages the full inventory lifecycle from supplier ordering to plate usage, simplifying supply chains and reducing food waste.

product.name: Workforce Management
product.description: Facilitates onboarding, scheduling, and team engagement to optimize labor deployment and reduce labor costs.

product.name: Payroll
product.description: Automates payroll processing from employee registration to payment, including pension contributions and query management.

product.name: Nory Capital
product.description: Provides fast financing solutions for restaurant businesses with loans up to £2 million and approvals within 24 hours.
